verdict.rationale: Pipedream exposes a full REST API, SDKs (TS/Python/Java), and MCP servers that let developers manage auth, connect accounts, and call any of 3,000+ APIs programmatically, including a proxy for endpoints without pre-built tools — suggesting the core functionality of the UI (connecting accounts, managed auth, tool calls) is API/MCP-accessible. However, the evidence never explicitly claims full UI/API feature parity or lists any UI-only capability not exposed via API. Missing for 10: explicit parity statement enumerating all UI features vs API/MCP equivalents, and independent/hands-on confirmation that no UI-only functionality exists.
